source_determined_failure_predicate.description: FluxSweep maps PointWallStatus.invalid_high_traction to this exact Fatal. assemble_point already rejects invalid direction/species/pointers at entry. stationary_candidate then rejects a finite negative normal high traction before computing any low/bar/limiter factor. A nonfinite optional trial has a different disposition. The raw failing face index, actual high value and its cached acoustics were not recorded.
source_determined_failure_predicate.Helm_capability: The active Helm implementation has no roe_gamma_minus_one capability; the special exact gamma-law moving-wall branch is not instantiated. It uses the selected mirrored HLLC high and generic LLF point-factor branch. get_gamma returns invalid for a real EOS without thermodynamic state; effective Gamma1 does not authorize the gamma-law wall formula.

ENTR_definition_verified.definition: ENTR=P/pow(rho,Gamma1), explicitly an entropy proxy rather than thermodynamic entropy.
Gamma1=rho*c_s^2/P from the authoritative EOS pressure/acoustic callbacks.

derived_t0_diagnostic_not_face_measureme.derivation: Gamma1≈ln(P/ENTR)/ln(rho), c_s≈sqrt(Gamma1*P/rho). Rounding of the stored proxy makes these inferred diagnostics rather than direct cached-acoustic values.
derived_t0_diagnostic_not_face_measureme.symmetric_mirrored_formula: For equal reflected points with u_L=-u,u_R=+u, symmetric wave bounds S_L=-a,S_R=a give S_star=0 and HLLC normal traction P-rho*u*(a-u). The existing HLL bounds have a>=u+c, hence p_star<=P-rho*u*c. The original LLF normal low on the same mirrored point pair is also P-rho*u*c.
derived_t0_diagnostic_not_face_measureme.reproducible_condition: Use the measured uniform lower-wall t0 point rho=8e7,P=2.53654798117401e25,u=9.5e8 with inferred c≈6.68536731016006e8, its exact normal-momentum mirror, and the original symmetric HLLC/LLF formulas. u exceeds P/(rho*c) by about2.003, yielding a negative derived traction. This is a conditional arithmetic diagnosis from the saved initial point, not an observed failing runtime face flux.
limits: Actual failing high/low/acoustics and face identity were not sampled. No value -2.54433e25 is claimed as an actual failing-face measurement.
